key.decision_why: The author answered both of laurynmm's asks in the description without a new push, and no maintainer was assigned to the PR. A short note telling the triager the PR is ready to move on is useful, but a new card isn't needed.
key.action_why: laurynmm reviewed the PR and said the changes look good. She removed "not ready", added "integration review" and assigned sahil839, without asking the author for more work.
changed: The author filled in the self-review checklist from the template in the PR description.
The author added before/after images of the POST /reminders parameter block to the description.
The author added a link to the current published page (https://zulip.com/api/create-message-reminder) for comparison.
The author explained that the images come from api_arguments_table_generator.py with portico CSS, not from a running dev server, and offered to redo them.
key.reply_ask: Thank the author for adding the checklist, the before/after images and the current-docs link, and say the PR is moving on to maintainer review.

must_have.fact: Says both of laurynmm's asks were answered: the self-review checklist is filled in, and before/after images with a link to the current docs page are now in the description.
Recommends handing off: remove "not ready", add a review label and assign a reviewer, rather than asking for more work.
Notes that the images were generated from zulip.yaml with api_arguments_table_generator.py rather than taken from a running docs server, and treats this as acceptable for a 3-line schema change.
Notes there was no new code push: the change is still the +3-line `required` array that marks message_id and scheduled_delivery_timestamp as required.
Suggests laurynmm (who gave the feedback and is a frequent contributor to zulip.yaml) or another API-docs maintainer such as sahil839 as the reviewer.
